Hand-checked pairing rules are in docs/CANDIDATE_MARKETS.md. This file is NOT an API response. It holds identifiers, question text and scheduled close times. It holds no prices and does not record which way any market went: that is deliberately left to the replay owner (#20).

window_rule.reference_close: per pair: the earlier of the two venues' scheduled closes when they are within 3 days of each other, otherwise the Kalshi close_time (flagged close_mismatch_days). The same reference is used for BOTH venues so their windows match. The collector also refuses any window that ends less than min_lead_days before a venue's own scheduled close.
